prompts.bridge: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE isolated transparent PNG game architecture sprite for The Last Sanctuary. Match the reference ONLY for tactile hand-painted resin, natural weathered stone, fine moss/lichen, subdued olive/slate palette and elevated tabletop perspective; do not copy its hex tile. Premium intricate sculpted collectible diorama, convincing stone joints and worn edges, warm upper-left light, subtle cool fill. Orthographic elevated front three-quarter view looking down about 38 degrees, slightly from the right. Full object, generous clear transparent margin, no backdrop, no text, no watermark, no people, no hexagon or display plinth. Subject: a narrow medieval single-arch stone footbridge, ivory-grey block masonry, individual cobbled deck, low stone parapets, four square endposts with tiny antique bronze caps. Long axis runs away from viewer from lower center toward upper center, so visible deck leads front-to-back, NOT a left-to-right side elevation. Open arch visible from right side. Transparent air under arch. Only bridge itself; NO water, no riverbanks, no ground slab. Readable clear traversable walkway.
